DetachReason.description: Why a member left a connection, or why a stored grant did not attach on connect. `revokedByMember` / `revokedByPrincipal`: messaging/mux/revoke by that side. `epochBumped`: the member DID ran messaging/mux/revoke-all. `suspendedUnknownKey`: the unknown-key rule suspended the grant. `keyRotated`: the grant's signing key left the member DID's current authentication relationship (grant state `staleKey`). `expired`: the grant or attach reached its effective expiry. `accountBlocked`: the member's account was blocked. `superseded`: the member DID's own direct connection, or a newer connection of the same kind, now receives its live traffic; the member stays on this connection inactive. `admin`: an operator acted. `detachRequested`: the principal removed a session attach with messaging/mux/detach. `accountRemoved`: the member's account, or the principal's, was removed. `resolutionFailed`: the member DID could not be resolved when the grant was re-validated; the grant is not changed and is re-checked later. `connectionFull`: the grant is valid and stays stored, but this connection already carries `maxDidsPerConnection` members, so it was not attached here; it attaches on a connection with room, including this one's successor once the principal makes room and reconnects.
DetachReason.title: DetachReason

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GrantId.description: A grant's identifier, chosen by the member DID's signer and carried in its grant statement; a UUID is RECOMMENDED. A mediator refuses a grant whose identifier is already on the member DID's record.
GrantId.title: GrantId

MuxDid.description: A DID, carried verbatim and compared by exact string equality. Unlike the messaging family's `Vid`, never a hash: the mediator resolves it to verify a statement signed by it. For a member DID reached over TSP, the TSP VID is the DID itself.
MuxDid.title: MuxDid

schema.description: A durable notice from a mediator, stored in the recipient's inbox and delivered at least once, about grants the recipient must act on or know of: suspended, revoked, expiring, or present on a member DID. The members present depend on `notice`; see the specification. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

count.description: `grantsPresent` only, REQUIRED: grants on the member DID the mediator holds, in every state.

did.description: `grantsPresent` only, REQUIRED: the member DID the recipient authenticated as.

epoch.description: `grantsPresent` only, REQUIRED: the member DID's epoch now in force.

expiring.description: `grantsExpiring` only, REQUIRED: grants delegated to the recipient that have passed about three quarters of their lifetime.

notice.description: Which notice this is. Each kind carries the members the specification lists for it, and no others.

revocations.description: `grantsRevoked` only, REQUIRED: the recipient's grants that were revoked by someone other than the recipient.

suspended.description: `grantsPresent` only, REQUIRED: how many of them this authentication just suspended under the unknown-key rule.

suspensions.description: `grantsSuspended` only, REQUIRED: the recipient's grants that were suspended. They must be recreated by a fresh messaging/mux/grant signed by the member DID under its current epoch.

schema.title: Messaging — Mux Notice — payload
